stemMd: A city repaired more potholes than ever before, yet the number of unrepaired potholes increased. Which is the best explanation?

options.label: B
options.textMd: New potholes formed faster than crews repaired existing ones.

explanationMd: An outstanding stock rises whenever additions exceed removals. Record repair activity can coexist with a growing backlog if damage is appearing even faster. Compare the flow of new defects with the flow of completed repairs.

distractorRationale.a: Vehicle appearance does not change the stock of potholes.
distractorRationale.c: Lighting does not explain the arithmetic of formation and repair.
distractorRationale.e: Announcements do not determine net pothole numbers.
distractorRationale.d: Travel preferences do not establish the rate of new damage.
